description: Repair a program the reader refuses, changing only the lines its diagnostics flag. The engine makes the fixes that are mechanical (a missing `;`, an undeclared register's size, a measurement with no target, an unbounded while given the bound chosen, an angle the bit-exact method refuses rounded to the bits chosen with its rounding stated), and holds a fix you propose (`proposed`) to the flagged lines: any change to another line is rejected (J021) and nothing is changed. Returns the repaired program, each repair with its code and every line it changed, what needs a person with the reader's advice, and the verdict.

diagnostics.description: Codes you saw that reading the text does not raise (Q500).

dyadic_bits.description: Round each angle the bit-exact method refuses (Q500) to the nearest multiple of 2π/2^K.

max_iterations.description: The bound for an unbounded `while` on measured bits (Q310), as the person chose it.

proposed.description: Your repaired version: taken only if every changed line is a flagged one (or a line added beside one).

sizes.description: A register's size, for one used before it is declared (Q102).

name: repair_qasm

anyOf.description: A program repaired on the lines its diagnostics flag alone: the program as it now is, each repair with the code it answered and every line it changed, and what needs a person, with the reader's advice.

verdict.description: How far the engine checked an answer about a program, as one level of an ordered ladder (wai-quantum://docs/verdicts): refused, parsed, executed, evidence, proof. A level says how far the engine checked, not that the answer is good: holds says whether the intents held (true, false, or null when none was decided). A job's result carries one under verdict when the job gives an intent or asks for one, and the receipt seals it; both MCP servers state one beside every answer about a program.
